name: Color Dreams
notes: Mapper-11/Color Dreams physical board intent: one switchable 32 KiB PRG-ROM window, one switchable 8 KiB CHR-ROM window, shared 74LS377-style end-of-M2 latch, fixed H/V CIRAM wiring, no PRG RAM/IRQ, and standard AND-style CPU/ROM bus conflicts. Latch outputs D2-D3 belong to the original lockout-defeat circuit and do not bank memory.
